# Bundled local OCR runtime
PaddleOCR and PP-OCRv6 models: PaddlePaddle Authors, Apache-2.0. Source: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
PaddleOCR JS 0.4.2; OpenCV.js (@techstark/opencv-js 4.10.0-release.1): Apache-2.0.
ONNX Runtime Web 1.24.3: Microsoft, MIT. Source: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
Runtime package notices are in licenses/ and worker.js.LEGAL.txt. Official model URLs and SHA-256 hashes are in models.json.
The bundled worker is rebuilt from ../../ocr-build/; no remote recognition API is used.
